_comment: Update weekly specials. weekOf should be the Monday of the current week.

items.name: Ham & Vegetable Chowder
items.label: Soup of the Day
items.description: Slow-simmered ham with potatoes, carrots, onion, and a lightly creamy broth, finished with cheddar.

items.name: Winter Greens Salad
items.label: Seasonal Salad
items.description: Mixed greens with red onion, dried cranberries, toasted pecans, and shredded Parmesan. Dressing served on the side.

items.name: Roasted Turkey & Swiss Pressed
items.label: Featured Pressed Sandwich
items.description: Warm roasted turkey, baby swiss, and herb butter, pressed crisp on our house bread.

items.name: Warm Red Pepper & Onion Farro
items.label: Featured Side
items.description: Nutty farro tossed with roasted red pepper, softened red onion, olive oil, and herbs.

items.name: Dutch Apple Cake
items.label: Sweet Bite of the Day
items.description: Tender baked apples with warm spice and a golden crumb topping.
